nounGANs is a collection of 300 NFT stored on the Cardano blockchain.

This is just the beginning of our journey of bringing the power of generative AI to the NFT world. We plan to release many more AI-generated collections — and your nounGANs will serve as a mint pass to all of them. Once in the gang, always in the gang!

Our mindset is product-first. In addition to more art, we have many more exciting features we plan to release once the mint sells out. Stay tuned!
